description: This file defines the PreferencesService class for managing user preferences and authentication data using SharedPreferences in a Dart/Flutter project. It includes methods for initializing preferences, saving, retrieving, and clearing user tokens and profile information.

classes.name: PreferencesService
classes.description: A service class for managing user preferences and profile data using SharedPreferences.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Saves an authentication token to SharedPreferences.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Getter to retrieve the stored auth token.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the stored auth token from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: saveUserProfile
methods.description: Saves user profile information such as id, name, email, and role.

methods.name: userProfile
methods.description: Returns a map of the current user profile data.

methods.name: clearProfile
methods.description: Removes all stored user profile information from SharedPreferences.
